```{python}
#| label: fig-information-flow-comparison
#| fig-cap: 'Information Flow Comparison: Representative Democracy vs. RAPPA. RepDem compresses rich preference spaces into a single vote (severe information loss). RAPPA maintains high bandwidth through parallel pairwise channels, preserving preference intensity and trade-off information.'
#| echo: false

import graphviz
from IPython.display import Image as IPImage, display

from dih_models.plotting.graphviz_helper import setup_graphviz_style, render_graphviz_with_watermark

dot = graphviz.Digraph(comment='Information Flow Comparison', format='png')
dot.attr(rankdir='LR', compound='true', splines='ortho')
setup_graphviz_style(dot)

# -- Representative Democracy (Top): Bottleneck --
with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_repdem') as c:
    c.attr(label='Representative Democracy: Information Bottleneck', style='dashed', color='black')

    # Wide preference space (multiple issues)
    with c.subgraph(name='cluster_repdem_prefs') as prefs:
        prefs.attr(rank='same')
        for i, issue in enumerate(['Healthcare', 'Education', 'Defense', 'Infrastructure', 'Environment']):
            prefs.node(f'repdem_pref_{i}', issue, shape='box', style='filled', fillcolor='white', fontsize='8', color='black')

    # Bottleneck: single vote (black fill for emphasis on bottleneck)
    c.node('repdem_vote', 'Single Vote\n(Candidate A, B, or C)', shape='diamond', style='filled', fillcolor='black', fontcolor='white', fontsize='9', width='2.0', color='black')

    # Connect preferences to bottleneck (dashed to show constraint)
    for i in range(5):
        c.edge(f'repdem_pref_{i}', 'repdem_vote', color='black', style='dashed', penwidth='0.8')

    # Output: policy (with information loss)
    c.node('repdem_policy', 'Policy Outcome\n(High Information Loss)', shape='box', style='filled,rounded,dashed', fillcolor='white', fontsize='9', color='black')
    c.edge('repdem_vote', 'repdem_policy', color='black', penwidth='2.0')

# -- RAPPA (Bottom): Parallel Channels --
with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_rappa') as c:
    c.attr(label='RAPPA: High-Bandwidth Parallel Channels', style='solid', color='black', penwidth='2')

    # Wide preference space (same issues)
    with c.subgraph(name='cluster_rappa_prefs') as prefs:
        prefs.attr(rank='same')
        for i, issue in enumerate(['Healthcare', 'Education', 'Defense', 'Infrastructure', 'Environment']):
            prefs.node(f'rappa_pref_{i}', issue, shape='box', style='filled', fillcolor='white', fontsize='8', color='black')

    # Multiple pairwise channels (aggregation node)
    c.node('rappa_agg', 'Pairwise\nAggregation\n(10 channels)', shape='ellipse', style='filled', fillcolor='white', fontsize='9', width='1.8', color='black', penwidth='2')

    # Connect preferences to aggregation with multiple edges (solid, showing flow)
    for i in range(5):
        c.edge(f'rappa_pref_{i}', 'rappa_agg', color='black', penwidth='0.8')

    # Output: policy (with preserved information) - solid border for emphasis
    c.node('rappa_policy', 'Policy Outcome\n(Preserved Intensity)', shape='box', style='filled,rounded', fillcolor='white', fontsize='9', color='black', penwidth='2')
    c.edge('rappa_agg', 'rappa_policy', color='black', penwidth='2.0')

png_path = render_graphviz_with_watermark(dot, 'rappa-information-flow-diagram')
display(IPImage(str(png_path)))
```
